Manifest.Name: 可能是按键统一优化 / Probably Unified Hotkeys
Manifest.Author: 太湖白1231
Manifest.Description:
将原版与所有模组的快捷键与常规设置统一整合进官方 ESC「选项」页，全面重构「选项 / 全部展开 / 改造件 / 退出游戏」核心流畅度，并提供场景预设快照与剪贴板导入/导出。
【能做什么】 • 统一整理：上方原版官方分区与下方模组卡片均支持折叠、拼音检索、原生排版与一键「恢复默认」 • 按键增强：支持 Shift / Ctrl / Alt 组合键、鼠标侧键/组合，按 Esc 即可清空解绑为「无」 • 方案快照：内置 3 套本地场景预设槽位与剪贴板 JSON 一键导出/导入，秒级备份恢复快捷键、模组配置及强转表 • 搜索排重：支持简繁中文、英文与拼音搜索定位，自带 [!] 仅看冲突集中排查与防误触隔离 • 丝滑响应：闲置单线程分帧预热、离线窗口装配、单帧无过渡瞬切、改造件行池化复用及全模组极速秒退 • 智能本地化：三层根治式模组分区标题本地化引擎，彻底告别 speed.config.* 等原始代码键与未翻译英文段落 • 全自动黑盒探测 & 模组排查：基于只读 DseCecil 静态 IL 与 ModData 配置自动探测未接入官方界面的模组隐藏热键并纳入撞键预警；支持疑难项一键强转或标记「忽略(非按键)」 • 双语切换：支持简体中文 / English 实时切换（默认跟随游戏语言），可在改造件齿轮设置或本模组卡片中调整
【权限说明】 仅声明 files 只读用途：用于扫描本地已启用模组目录的 DLL 字节码（提取固定按键）并持久化读取缓存，不访问网络、不修改存档或其它模组文件。
【怎么使用】 按 ESC 打开「选项」→ 顶部搜索或展开/收起任意分区卡片 → 点击按键直接录入（按 Esc 清空，左/右键取消）→ 点击底部「应用」或「保存方案 / 导出剪贴板」保存生效。
---
Unifies vanilla and mod hotkeys & settings into the official ESC "Options" menu, overhauls responsiveness across Options, Expand All, Mods, and Quit Game, and introduces multi-scene profile snapshots with 1-click clipboard export/import.
[Features] • Unified View: Collapsible vanilla & mod cards with CN/EN/Pinyin search, native styling, and per-card "Reset" • Enhanced Keybinds: Supports Shift / Ctrl / Alt combos, mouse & side buttons, and Esc to unbind to "None" • Profile Snapshots: 3 built-in preset slots & 1-click Clipboard JSON Export/Import for hotkeys, mod settings, and forced tables • Conflict Check & Filter: Supports CN (Simp/Trad), EN & Pinyin search, "[!] Conflicts" view, and anti-leak combo guard • Smooth Performance: Idle frame warmup, off-screen batched assembly, pooled Mods list, and fast quit • Smart Localization: 3-layer universal section localization engine that permanently resolves raw keys like speed.config.* • Auto Hotkey Probe & Diagnostics: Read-only DseCecil IL + ModData scanning automatically uncovers hidden/hardcoded keys for conflict warnings; supports promoting raw entries or dismissing false positives ("Ignore (Not Key)") • Bilingual UI: Supports Simplified Chinese / English live switching (defaults to Follow Game Language) via the Mods gear settings or this mod's card
[Capability Note] Declares "files" strictly for read-only scanning of enabled mods' assemblies (detecting hardcoded keybinds) and storing probe metadata cache. Zero network calls, zero save/file tampering.
[How to Use] Press ESC → "Options" → search or expand/collapse cards → click any keybind to capture (Esc to clear, Left/Right click to cancel) → click "Apply" or "Save Preset / Export JSON" at the bottom.
